Title: Deprecation notice — use baldrick-broth and baldrick-reserve

Summary
- This project is now deprecated. Please migrate to baldrick-broth (the orchestrator) and baldrick-reserve (the templates source).

Why
- Decouple template updates from CLI releases.
- Allow local, project-specific behavior until templates are promoted to baldrick-reserve.

Migration
- Orchestrator: https://github.com/flarebyte/baldrick-broth
- Templates: https://github.com/flarebyte/baldrick-reserve

Status
- No further feature development or releases are planned for this package.
